required_fixes: Redefine structural_composite to be independent of behavioral failure: exclude 401/403 error response bodies from structural signal. Use only success-path signals (ETag, Cache-Control, dynamic timestamp/request_id hash for 2xx responses) or header-only structural signal. Current definition hashes full response body including constant error JSON, making structural signal deterministic function of behavioral state (expired structural std=0, valid std=0.265). This violates spec.json measurement_validity clause 7 'no shared variables between signal domains' and clause 1 'structural variation independent of behavioral state'.

Ensure expired-token responses still emit genuine structural variation: ETag/Cache-Control/dynamic content must vary independently of token state. Currently testbed_server.py @require_token returns 401 before apply_cache_headers/compute_etag, leaving etag='' and cache_control='' and constant body hash f6d40dd42dff2b868cbd3c36246e3f97471 for all 240 expired samples, violating measurement_validity clauses 2 and 4. Fix: emit ETag/Cache-Control even on 401 or compute structural signal from separate channel that is unaffected by auth failure.

Align result.json controls with frozen spec.json decision_rule. Spec C4 is TOST p_upper <0.05 at delta=0.15 and C5 is heterogeneity |r_cache_enabled - r_cache_disabled| <2*SE. Producer result.json implements C4_null_control as behavioral std check (observed_null_std=3.5 is behavioral, not structural) and C5_304_exercised as 304 rate >=0.10. Both mismap the frozen rule. Implement spec C4/C5 exactly or amend spec via formal prereg update before execution.

Fix report.md numerical inconsistencies: per-endpoint r in report Table 3.2 (0.2065,0.3491,0.3201) does not match result.json metrics.per_endpoint_r (0.3160,0.4303,0.3834) and recomputed values; per-cache r in report Table 3.3 (0.3062,0.2918) does not match result.json per_cache_r (0.3399,0.4120) and recomputed values. Variance gate values in report (behavioral_std 2.98) mismatch result.json (3.5). Regenerate report from result.json or correct recomputation.

Execute baseline B-FLASK-ONLY (spec.json baselines[1]): plain Flask without CDN/OAuth/dynamic content, same signal extraction but without infrastructure features, to isolate whether correlation is caused by infrastructure vs definitional confounding. No B-FLASK-ONLY data exists in raw_evidence or result.json.

Disclose and test per-token-state variance: report structural std conditioned on token_state, not only pooled per-endpoint. Pooled std masks degeneracy (expired structural std=0.0 unique=1 vs valid std=0.265 unique=167). Variance gate must require std>0 within each behavioral stratum per measurement_validity clause 1, or document heteroscedasticity and use stratified analysis.

Correct C4_null_control implementation: spec null_control expects structural std>0 with cache disabled and |r|<0.05 at lambda=0 (no behavioral drift). Producer computes null on behavioral scores (null_control_mean=3.5 std=3.5) and uses c4_pass=null_std>=0 tautology. Recompute on structural signal for cache-disabled AND on valid-token-only subset to test true null correlation.

Bound claim to local Flask testbed and disclose representation loss: provenance notes single-node Flask CDN simulation, not varnish/nginx multi-node, no concurrent load, no distributed coherence, jitter 10-200ms not 10-500ms per spec, binary behavioral signal (0 vs 7) not graded, hash %10000 structural proxy not schema-hash+etag_variation+cache_control_variation as prereg 4.3 describes.
validity_findings: V1_CRITICAL_SHARED_VARIABLE_CONFOUND: Structural signal is defined as hash(body)%10000 including 401 error body. Expired token path returns constant error JSON (response_sha256 f6d40dd42dff2b868cbd3c36246..., structural_composite 0.671000 constant, n=240, std=0.0) while valid path returns varied bodies (mean 0.5194, std 0.2648, unique 167). Behavioral signal is binary 0 (valid) vs 7 (expired). Pearson r=0.375 is forced mean-shift between degenerate and varied distributions, not independent CDN/OAuth correlation. Violates spec.json measurement_validity[6] independent extraction and [0] independent variation. Evidence: raw_evidence/experiment_data.json expired structural std 0.0 unique 1 vs valid std 0.2648; testbed_server.py:381-391 @require_token early return without ETag/Cache-Control; run_experiment.py:399-403 structural_composite from body_sha256 including error body.

V2_CRITICAL_STRUCTURAL_DEGENERACY_EXPIRED: Per-token-state structural variance =0 for expired, violating genuine structural stochastic variation requirement. Pooled per-endpoint structural_std 0.19-0.217 in result.json metrics.per_endpoint_variance masks this by mixing valid+expired clusters. Spec requires genuine variation in BOTH domains; expired condition contributes no structural information, so correlation is undefined within that stratum. Recomputed: expired structural std 0.0000, valid 0.2648. Evidence: recomputed_metrics expired vs valid split; raw_evidence/experiment_data.json per-condition samples show etag='' cache_control='' for all expired.

V3_MAJOR_DECISION_RULE_MISMATCH: Frozen spec decision_rule C4=TOST p_upper<0.05 and C5=|r_en - r_dis|<2*SE. Producer controls map C4 to 'structural std>0 with cache disabled' (but implemented on behavioral scores, observed_null_std=3.5) and C5 to '304 rate >=10%'. Spec C4/C5 not tested as written. Recomputed spec C5 heterogeneity: |0.3399-0.4120|=0.0721 <2*SE 0.0916 PASS; spec C4 TOST p_upper=0.9999999 FAIL. Producer's C4/C5 PASS therefore does not demonstrate spec compliance. Evidence: spec.json decision_rule vs result.json controls C4_null_control/C5_304_exercised; run_experiment.py:621-644.

V4_MAJOR_REPORT_RESULT_INCONSISTENCY: report.md Table per-endpoint r (0.2065,0.3491,0.3201) and per-cache r (0.3062,0.2918) do not match result.json metrics (0.3160,0.4303,0.3834 and 0.3399,0.4120) nor recomputed values (verified equal to result.json). Report also lists behavioral_std 2.98 vs result 3.5 and misstates null_control. Indicates report generation not derived from result.json, undermining provenance chain.

V5_MAJOR_C4_NULL_CONTROL_TAUTOLOGY: result.json controls.C4_null_control threshold 'structural signal std>0 with cache disabled' observed_null_mean 3.5 std 3.5 is actually behavioral statistics (mean 3.5 is binary 0/7 mean). Run_experiment.py:624-631 computes null_behavioral from cond_b behavioral scores for nocache, not structural. Pass condition null_std>=0 is tautologically true. Does not test spec null_control expectation |r|<0.05 at lambda=0.

V6_MODERATE_BASELINE_OMISSION: Baseline B-FLASK-ONLY not executed. No evidence whether plain Flask without infrastructure also shows correlation under same confounded definition, so producer cannot attribute r=0.375 to CDN/OAuth/dynamic content. B-LOCALHOST-MOCK comparison notes prior r 0.002-0.046 but those experiments likely used different structural definition (stable-identifier hash vs full body hash) — comparison confounds definition change with infrastructure change.

V7_MODERATE_MEASUREMENT_VALIDITY_DISCLOSURE_GAP: Validity_notes claim 'Production-like testbed: CDN simulation ETag-SHA256, stale-while-revalidate' but implementation is Flask in-memory CDNCache with max-age=30, not varnish/nginx; jitter is 10-200ms not 10-500ms; behavioral signal is binary 0/7, not graded 4-signal composite per prereg; structural uses body hash %10000, not specified response_schema_hash+cache_control_variation+etag_variation+dynamic_content_hash weighted composite. Representation loss not fully disclosed.

V8_MINOR_POWER_AND_CI_CORRECT: Recomputation confirms primary statistic: pooled r=0.3751447 n=480 Fisher z 0.394397 SE 0.045786 CI [0.295567,0.449553] TOST at delta 0.15 p_upper 0.9999999 FAIL, at delta 0.20 p_upper 0.999985 FAIL. Variance gate 3/3 endpoints std>0 pooled PASS, C1 TP 1.0 PASS, 304 rate 0.3167 PASS are correctly computed. Statistical computation is sound; inferential validity fails due to confounded constructs, not arithmetic.
baseline_findings: B-LOCALHOST-MOCK (spec baselines[0], prior EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 r=0.0022 CI upper 0.0916 PASS and EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 r=0.0463 CI upper 0.1353 PASS): Producer correctly notes dramatic increase to r=0.375, but increase is confounded with structural definition change (prior used schema_diff/Jaccard and stable-identifier ETag not full error-body hash; current uses body_sha256%10000 including error body). Without holding definition constant, baseline delta cannot be attributed to production-like infrastructure. Baseline comparison is measurement-invalid due to construct shift.

B-FLASK-ONLY (spec baselines[1] plain Flask without CDN/OAuth/dynamic content): NOT EXECUTED. No data in raw_evidence, result.json, or report.md. Spec expects |r|<0.15 on plain Flask to test infrastructure irrelevance. Omission prevents discriminating whether correlation is infrastructure-induced vs definition-induced. Required for product consequence decision per spec.

Positive control TP (spec positive_control): PASS verified — recomputed expired TP 1.0 (240/240 behavioral_delta=7) and valid TN 1.0 (240/240 delta=0) mean 1.0 >=0.85, consistent with prior. Control correctly indicates behavioral extraction functional, but does not rescue structural degeneracy.

Null control (spec null_control): FAIL to test as specified — expected structural std>0 with cache disabled and |r|<0.05 at lambda=0. Producer tests behavioral std tautology and does not compute correlation at lambda=0 (valid-token-only). Recomputed cache_disabled structural std 0.2308 >0 is true, but valid-only correlation not reported; recomputed per-cache r values (0.3399 vs 0.4120) both >0.15 and not <0.05, but they mix token states, not lambda=0 isolation.
claim_ceiling: No justified claim about C-FRESHNESS orthogonality on production-like infrastructure. The observed r=0.375 CI [0.2956,0.4496] is a valid descriptive statistic for this implementation but measurement-invalid for the frozen hypothesis: structural signal is confounded with behavioral state via constant 401 error-body hashing and missing ETag/Cache-Control on expired responses, violating independent extraction. Maximum justified ceiling remains localhost Flask mock: pooled r=0.0022 CI upper 0.0916 <0.15 (EXP-GRAPH-35389145821, audit PASS) and stochastic mock r=0.0463 CI upper 0.135 <0.15 — C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to localhost Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL + in-memory cache + PyJWT, n=480. Production-like testbed demonstrates that naive body-hash structural definition cannot be orthogonal to auth failure by construction (error bodies differ), not that CDN/OAuth/dynamic content introduce correlation. No advancement toward VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE; parallel-channel architecture not falsified nor validated by this experiment.
unresolved: Whether orthogonality holds on production-like infrastructure when structural signal is correctly defined to be independent of auth error bodies (header-only or success-only body hash) — requires re-run with fixed signal extraction.
Whether B-FLASK-ONLY baseline (plain Flask without CDN/OAuth/dynamic) is orthogonal under corrected definition — needed to attribute any residual correlation to infrastructure.

Whether expired responses should carry structural headers (ETag/Cache-Control) in production APIs — if production APIs also omit ETags on 401, definitional orthogonality may be impossible and claim scope must be narrowed to success-path freshness.

Whether per-token-state heteroscedasticity (valid varied, expired constant) reflects real production behavior or testbed artifact — concurrent load, distributed cache, or error-body variability in production could change structure.

What structural signal formulation (e.g., ETag variation, cache_control_variation, request_id entropy, schema hash of success bodies only) satisfies independent extraction while retaining product relevance for freshness detection.
Whether jitter 10-500ms vs 10-200ms or multi-node CDN vs single-node Flask cache changes correlation when measurement is valid — not tested due to invalid confound dominating effect.
Report generation pipeline: source of per-endpoint/per-cache discrepancies between report.md and result.json — whether reporting or recomputation path introduced error.
